design_philosophy.theme_style: Supervisório Industrial Limpo (Clean SCADA / Technical Ergonomics)
design_philosophy.concept: Precision Industrial Automation meets Swiss Technical Clarity. High scannability, functional contrast, status-driven visual hierarchy, zero fluff.

hierarchy.h1_hero: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-black tracking-tight leading-none uppercase
hierarchy.h2_section: text-xl sm:text-2xl lg:text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100
hierarchy.h3_card_title: text-base sm:text-lg font-semibold tracking-normal text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-200
hierarchy.body: text-sm sm:text-base font-normal leading-relaxed text-slate-600 dark:text-slate-300
hierarchy.mono_data: font-mono text-xs sm:text-sm font-medium tracking-wider uppercase text-cyan-700 dark:text-cyan-400

sidebar_and_navigation.desktop: Fixed 260px left sidebar, dark petroleum slate (#080c14), sharp high-contrast border-r (#1e293b)
sidebar_and_navigation.mobile: Sticky top bar with branding + hamburger toggle opening a drawer OR fixed bottom bar on small devices

svg_hvac_schematic.flow_direction: Retorno (Esquerda) -> Filtro G4 -> Serpenteador (Serpentina/Válvula VAG) -> Ventilador -> Insuflamento (Direita)

valve_indicator.vag_percentage_display: Badge showing 0-100% opening with color gradient

temperature_sensors.t_retorno: Sensor T_RET (°C) at air return duct
temperature_sensors.setpoint_badge: Target SP in high-visibility digital box

key_modules_and_pages.login: Login with JWT support, simulation shortcut, and mandatory first-time password change modal
key_modules_and_pages.dashboard_home: General building elevation with dual column fancoil matrix (Left = Lado 1, Right = Lado 2, sorted Top 20th floor down to Ground Floor 1st floor). Top key metric cards: Total Fancoils, Ligados, Forçados, Offline, Alarmes Ativos, Temp Média.
key_modules_and_pages.fancoil_general_view: Interactive building schematic view with instant filter (By floor, status, or search CJ171). Side 1 (Lado 1) and Side 2 (Lado 2) alignment with live green/red/amber status dots.
key_modules_and_pages.fancoil_detail_view: Animated HVAC SVG schematic, live telemetry panel (CONDIÇÃO, QUADRO, OPERAÇÃO, COMANDO, STATUS, TEMPERATURA, SETPOINT, VÁLVULA VAG %, COMUNICAÇÃO), setpoint control +/-0.5°C, Auto/Forçado toggle, ON/OFF command, and 24h/7d/30d Recharts historical trend graph.
key_modules_and_pages.alarms_module: Active alarm table with blinking red severity, acknowledgement button (Reconhecer Alarme), filter by date, floor, or status.
key_modules_and_pages.reports_module: Tabbed reports: Log de Comandos, Histórico de Temperatura, Horas de Funcionamento, Log de Acesso. Export CSV button.
key_modules_and_pages.admin_panel: User management (Admin, Operador, Visualizador), Fancoil cadastral registry (CJ+andar+lado), MQTT Broker Configuration panel, Simulation Mode toggle switch, and Building Image upload setting.

testing_attributes.rule: Every interactive button, input, toggle, tab, link, table row, and metric card MUST include data-testid
testing_attributes.naming_convention: kebab-case starting with role or action

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a high-performance Portuguese-Brazilian (pt-BR) supervisory application.
Ensure simulation mode is enabled by default so data flows dynamically immediately on launch.
Strictly follow JavaScript/React .js and .jsx syntax rules.
Use Lucide-React icons extensively with explicit sizes and stroke widths for a clean industrial SCADA feel.
Ensure all buttons and inputs are easily clickable with clear hover state contrast.
Implement Sonner for crisp industrial toast notifications (e.g., 'Comando enviado ao CJ171 com sucesso', 'Modo Simulação Ativado').
Do NOT use pure transparent backgrounds on header, dropdown menus, or modal overlays; use dark slate with backdrop blur.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Dark colors look best with solid dark slate backgrounds, avoid dirty full-screen color gradients.
Ensure 2x-3x padding inside cards and bordered sections so technical data text never collides with edges.
Maintain strict APCA high contrast for status badges, temperature readings, and SCADA indicators.
Never use raw emoji as system icons. Use lucide-react vector icons.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include data-testid attributes.
